test_DatetimeIndex_unique: test the DatetimeIndex.unique() method to return unique values from a DatetimeIndex with duplicate entries
test_DatetimeIndex_nunique: test the DatetimeIndex.nunique() method to count unique values, with and without NaT entries
test_DatetimeIndex_tz_localize: test the DatetimeIndex.tz_localize() method to localize a timezone-naive index to a specific timezone
test_tm_assert_index_equal: test the tm.assert_index_equal() function to verify two DatetimeIndex objects are equal
test_DatetimeIndex_is_unique: test the DatetimeIndex.is_unique property to check whether a DatetimeIndex contains duplicate values
